evals.name: memory-module-review
evals.prompt: Review the newly added `memory` module (every file in server/src/modules/memory/) of the fixture server excerpt. Find architecture / layering problems: code in the wrong layer, imports that cross a boundary they should not. For each finding: file:line, what is wrong, why, and the concrete fix. Things that look suspicious but are fine go to 'Checked and OK'. Write review.md.
evals.expected_output: 3 planted violations found, legal type-only db/rows import not flagged
assertions: Flags the Drizzle query / db imports inside the GET /memory/:id handler in routes.ts
Flags MemoryItem.parse(req.body) in the handler instead of route schema.body
Flags service.ts importing/instantiating RepoService from the sibling repos module
Does NOT report the type-only MemoryRow import from db/rows.js (helpers.ts) as a violation
Primary fix for the cross-module call goes through the container (container.<x>Repo) or a shared contract, not through another call to the repos module's service

evals.name: evals-module-review

evals.name: reports-module-review-large
evals.prompt: Review the change set that adds the `reports` module: every file in server/src/modules/reports/, plus server/src/modules/_shared/report-access.ts and server/src/platform/report-cache.ts. Find architecture / layering problems: code in the wrong layer, imports that cross a boundary they should not, rules that the import checker would not catch. For each finding: file:line, what is wrong, why, and the concrete fix. Things that look suspicious but are fine go to 'Checked and OK'. Write review.md.
evals.expected_output: 8 planted violations (easy, medium and tool-invisible) found; 3 legal look-alikes not flagged
assertions: Flags the route handler in routes.ts that calls container.github().postReview itself (orchestration and payload building belong in the service)
Flags repository getById/remove (and the export/delete paths that drop workspaceId) as not scoped by workspace
Flags the deep import reviewer-core/src/review/blockers.js in service.ts (bypasses reviewer-core's public entry)
Flags platform/report-cache.ts importing from modules/reports (platform must not import modules)
Flags compose() doing deleteForPull then insert as two writes with no transaction
Flags repository.ts listForPull returning DTOs through toReportDto imported from helpers.ts (ring 3 shaping API output)
Flags scoring.ts reading process.env and Date.now() while the service treats it as a pure business rule
Flags _shared/report-access.ts importing RepoService from modules/repos as a cross-module back door
Does NOT report the parseUnifiedDiff import from adapters/git/diff-parser.js as a violation
Does NOT report container.reviewRepo usage in service.ts as a violation
Does NOT report the type-only ComposedReviewRow import from db/rows.js as a violation
